nodes.plm_caption: The video features several different clips taken from various sources. The first clip shows a series of shots of a large coffee cup and then it cuts to an individual blending up some fruit in a blender. Then it shows them putting the fruits into a dish. And then cutting up the dish and making it look pretty with different toppings, and then they start editing the photo on a computer.

summary.brief: The creator makes a vegan blue ice‑cream bowl, decorates it, edits a photo of the bowl on a computer, and ends with Instagram‑style closing screens.
summary.detailed: The video opens with a close‑up of blue chai tea mixed with a small amount of water, which turns the liquid a vivid blue. Frozen bananas are sliced on a red cloth, placed into a black blender, and blended together with the blue liquid and a touch of lemon zest. The smooth blue mixture is poured into a white bowl. The presenter adds puffed amaranth, a selection of fresh fruit pieces and a sprinkle of coconut, creating a colorful vegan ice‑cream bowl that is shown from several angles. The scene then switches to a laptop screen where a hand with purple nail polish lifts the photo of the bowl, loads it into a photo‑editing program, and adjusts color balance, lighting and other settings using side‑by‑side preview panels and tool menus until a final edited image is produced. The video finishes with a series of Instagram‑style closing graphics thanking viewers and displaying the creator’s Instagram handle.

action.brief: Prepare vegan blue ice cream bowl and edit its photo
action.detailed: Chop frozen bananas, blend them with blue chai tea, water and lemon zest, pour the blue mixture into a bowl, top it with puffed amaranth, assorted fruit and coconut, then open a photo‑editing program on a computer and adjust the picture’s colors and lighting before saving the final edited image.
action.actor: a person with purple‑nail‑polished hands (the video presenter)

nodes.plm_caption:
The video features a close-up of ingredients in a cup. A person cuts and blends bananas. Finally, the person pours ingredients into a bowl. The video includes a shot of the final dish.
Several scenes, including a cup of ingredients, a person slicing bananas, and a person blending them in a blender. A final scene shows the person pouring the ingredients into a bowl.
The video begins with a close-up of a cup with a blue colored drink in it. The contents are blurred, making it hard to see. A hand with purple nail polish appears with a white mug. It touches the rim of the mug before the hand exits frame. On the left side, a bunch of bananas are placed on a red cloth. The bananas are white and fresh. A person enters the shot and cuts the bananas from the stalk with a sharp knife. The bananas are chopped and dropped into a black blender. Several close-ups of the bananas in the blender show them being mixed together. The person picks up a measuring cup and pours chocolate sauce into the blender. The lid is closed and the blender is started. More close-ups of the blended bananas show them mixed together. The video ends with a hand reaching into a white cup that has fruit, ice cream, and nuts. The cup sits on a gray surface. The video is set against a background of white tiles. The tiles have images of mugs and coffee cups painted on them. The colors of the video are blue, white, and black.

summary.brief: A person blends bananas with blue chai tea and chocolate sauce, then builds a topped blue ice‑cream bowl.
summary.detailed: The clip opens with a close‑up of a blue‑colored drink in a white mug, the hand holding the mug showing purple nail polish. A bunch of bananas lies on a red cloth; the person slices the bananas and drops the pieces into a black blender. Blue chai tea (mixed with a little water that turns blue) and a drizzle of chocolate sauce are added, the lid is closed and the mixture is blended until smooth, creating a light‑blue ice‑cream base. The blue mixture is poured into a white bowl on a gray surface. The creator then adds a handful of puffed amaranth, a sprinkle of coconut flakes, sliced almonds and assorted fresh fruit such as banana slices and berries, along with a few cookies or muesli pieces. A wooden spoon rests beside the bowl. The final, fully topped blue ice‑cream bowl is shown from above against a brick‑like background.

action.brief: Prepare and assemble a blue ice‑cream bowl
action.detailed: Slice bananas, blend them with blue chai tea and a drizzle of chocolate sauce, pour the smooth blue mixture into a bowl, then top it with puffed amaranth, coconut, sliced almonds, fresh fruit and cookies before presenting the finished dessert.
action.actor: A person whose hands are visible, with purple‑nail‑polished fingers

summary.detailed: The segment opens with a laptop screen showing a photo‑editing program. A hand with purple nail polish appears from the bottom‑right of the screen and briefly holds a bowl of blue ice‑cream before disappearing. The interface displays the main image of the bowl (blue ice‑cream, wooden spoon, white bowl) in the center, with smaller thumbnails on the left and right. Editing panels, histograms, sliders and a timeline of thumbnails are visible on the right side. The hand moves the mouse and clicks tools, adjusting color balance, hue and contrast, and applying filters; the picture shifts from its original blue tone to slightly altered hues (green, grey) as the controls are manipulated. The view switches between side‑by‑side before‑and‑after versions, and the edited image is repeatedly shown in larger and smaller windows. After a series of adjustments a large pop‑up appears showing the final edited result. The screen then fades to a series of Instagram‑style graphics that display “thanks for watching,” the Instagram handle @LulusDreamtown, and decorative images of ice‑cream and cake, concluding the segment.

A montage of a young female going about her morning routine and prepping ingredients for a smoothie with a graphic background featuring a pan of food. There is a lot of text in the montage. 
The woman begins with morning yoga and meditation, then switches to a coffee break with a coffee mug and tea. She then proceeds to cut and blend various fruits and vegetables as she makes a smoothie. At the end, there is an empty plate.

summary.brief: A young woman chops bananas, blends them with green ingredients and blue‑purple liquid, stirs the mixture, and pours the smooth smoothie into a bowl while coupon text appears on screen.
summary.detailed: The segment opens with animated title cards that read “Cooking with Lulu.” A close‑up then shows a white ceramic mug and two bananas on a red cutting board; the woman lifts the mug, grabs a knife and slices the bananas into smaller pieces. The banana slices are placed into a large clear‑glass blender set against a tiled wall. She adds handfuls of green leafy material and a blue‑purple liquid, then closes the lid and runs the blender until the contents become a smooth, blue‑tinged mixture. After blending, she picks up a red rubber (silicone) spatula and uses it to stir or demonstrate the blended mixture, and later a red spoon is shown mixing inside the blender. Finally she pours the smoothie into a tan/white bowl on the counter. Throughout the clip on‑screen text promotes a 10 % coupon (e.g., “10z coupon ‘Dreamtown’”, “10z coupon ‘Lillu2016’”).

action.detailed: Cut the bananas, place the pieces in a blender, add green ingredients and blue‑purple liquid, blend until smooth, stir the blended mixture with a spatula, and pour the resulting smoothie into a bowl.
action.actor: A young woman, visible by her hands and a brief view of her face

First a green‑colored base is poured into the bowl, then a generous spoonful of yellow granola is scattered over it. A second spoonful of a green‑ish mixture (appearing like a thick paste) is added, followed shortly by two scoops of bright blue ice cream placed on top. The hand then arranges sliced strawberries, banana pieces, blueberries, blackberries and small cookie or donut fragments around the edges of the bowl, and positions a wooden spoon and a few extra nuts or granola nearby. The final frame shows the fully built, multi‑layered dessert against a brick background.
